supersessionRows.oldCriterion: appendActions returns success only after durable persistence is confirmed; a non-persisted/degraded result must be a failed invoke with the failsafe retained.
supersessionRows.replacementCriterion: Exact-request primary failure plus confirmed write-ahead retention returns classified queued/degraded success; mismatch, unconfirmed recovery, or total loss returns nonzero.
supersessionRows.rationale: Confirmed queued persistence is an approved successful degraded outcome.

supersessionRows.oldCriterion: appendActions must not report success when Invoke-ReplPersistTurn returns false or leaves a failsafe record.
supersessionRows.replacementCriterion: A confirmed queued result is successful degraded workflow completion with persisted=false; only total loss is failure.
supersessionRows.rationale: The three-outcome contract separates queued success from primary persistence and loss.

supersessionRows.oldCriterion: When updateTurn title persistence times out or returns HTTP 503, the wrapper exits non-zero if the title was not persisted.
supersessionRows.replacementCriterion: When the title is not primarily persisted but a prewritten failsafe is confirmed, return queued/degraded success; nonzero is required only when neither primary persistence nor confirmed recovery exists.
retainedObligations: Previous server title remains until replay
supersessionRows.rationale: Approved write-ahead semantics treat confirmed queue retention as successful degraded persistence.

supersessionRows.oldCriterion: A validation failure caused by omitted planFile leaves no pending session_submit failsafe.
supersessionRows.replacementCriterion: Write-ahead recovery created before submission remains pending after validation or backend rejection until durable resolution; invalid metadata inserts no server row.
supersessionRows.rationale: Deleting write-ahead evidence on validation failure conflicts with the approved retention contract.

supersessionRows.oldCriterion: Recovery or session rotation rebinds current-turn.yaml to the recovered session and incremental persistence succeeds on that rebound identity.
supersessionRows.replacementCriterion: An already-bound workspace, agent, session, and request identity is immutable; drift is rejected without rebinding. Metadata recovery occurs only within the exact bound identity.
retainedObligations: None sentinel for truly absent values
supersessionRows.rationale: The approved identity contract prohibits marker-driven or recovery-driven rebinding.

requirementStore.oldText:
Plugin workflow.sessionlog.appendDialog SHALL persist dialog items through SessionLogClient.AppendDialogAsync (POST /mcpserver/sessionlog/{agent}/{sessionId}/{requestId}/dialog) without a full-session SubmitAsync upsert when the turn already exists.

Acceptance Criteria:
- After a successful beginTurn, appendDialog returns success while TODO/requirements queries succeed in the same process.
- Server turn GET then contains the appended dialog items.
- Test double or recorded call: method is AppendDialogAsync or POST dialog, not SubmitAsync of the full session DTO.
- Missing turn is classified not-found, retryable false; failsafe is not used for that 404.
requirementStore.newText:
Plugin workflow.sessionlog.appendDialog SHALL persist dialog items through SessionLogClient.AppendDialogAsync (POST /mcpserver/sessionlog/{agent}/{sessionId}/{requestId}/dialog) without a full-session SubmitAsync upsert when the turn already exists.

Acceptance Criteria:
- After a successful beginTurn, appendDialog returns success while TODO/requirements queries succeed in the same process.
- Server turn GET then contains the appended dialog items.
- Test double or recorded call: method is AppendDialogAsync or POST dialog, not SubmitAsync of the full session DTO.
- A missing turn on a never-degraded appendDialog path is classified not-found, retryable false; no failsafe is created for that 404. This does not override degraded MCP/service recovery and failsafe retention governed by FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-001-AC004.
requirementStore.rationale: Resolve normative 404 contradiction: no-failsafe applies only to never-degraded missing-turn 404; degraded recovery remains governed by FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-001-AC004.

requirementStore.oldText: A missing turn is classified not_found with retryable false, does not create a failsafe for that 404, and does not increment the local auditDialog count.
requirementStore.newText: On a never-degraded appendDialog path, a missing turn is classified not_found with retryable false, does not create a failsafe for that 404, and does not increment the local auditDialog count; this criterion does not override degraded MCP/service recovery and failsafe retention governed by FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-001-AC004.
requirementStore.rationale: Make the approved never-degraded qualifier normative in the MCP requirement while preserving degraded recovery behavior.
